summary: To add a module to an existing collection, create plugins/modules/my_test.py under the collection path, paste the template, and extend it.
questions: Where does a new module file go in a collection?

answer_card.title: Create a module in a collection
answer_card.answer_md: Create `<PATH_TO_COLLECTION>/ansible_collections/my_namespace/my_collection/plugins/modules/my_test.py`, paste the template, and extend it.
